assets.label: 法兰西的破碎时代背景
assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: production background illustration for a Hearts of Iron IV mod's French civil-war decision panel, intended final size 510 x 440 pixels.
Primary request: original, painterly historical strategy-game art for "France in a fractured age", France circa the 1930s amid competing local governments. Generate actual finished bitmap artwork, not a UI mockup.
Composition: near-square landscape aspect 51:44. The top 20 percent is a cinematic vignette: on the upper RIGHT, anonymous French militia silhouettes in greatcoats and Adrian helmets beside a damaged limestone town hall, distant factory smoke and a tiny worn blue-white-red French cloth ribbon; a faded engraved France-map motif behind them. Keep the upper LEFT almost empty and very dark to support a two-line interface heading. The lower 80 percent is a very quiet, dark charcoal green-gray parchment/steel surface with subtle scratches and extremely faint old cartographic linework, suitable behind readable statistics and icons. Avoid bright figures, major scenery or high contrast detail in this lower area. The dramatic vignette must fade smoothly into this lower negative space, with no hard horizon band.
Style: hand-painted archival war illustration with etched details, aged print grain, realistic 1930s material, restrained light; premium historical grand-strategy UI artwork. Muted charcoal, desaturated slate green, antique brass highlights, very sparse dark crimson. Opaque background. Art extends to every edge.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, interface controls, borders, badges, logos or watermark; no identifiable leaders; no modern tactical gear; no gore; no copied TNO or Paradox artwork. Ensure all prominent subject matter fits in the top-right fifth and will survive reduction to a small GUI backdrop.

assets.label: 筹划边境战役
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished transparent raster decision icon for a 1930s French civil-war historical strategy game. Original hand-painted metallic emblem, matching Hearts of Iron IV's restrained historical icon scale but with original artwork: antique brass, cool gunmetal steel, a little ivory parchment, one sparse muted crimson accent. Strong high-contrast rim lighting, engraved metal texture, simplified large shapes that remain instantly legible at 32 x 32 and 48 x 48 pixels. Front-facing centered composition, approximately square, icon occupies the central 78 percent, all elements fully inside generous transparent padding. Genuine alpha background, no solid backdrop or baked checkerboard, no framed square, no text, digits, letters, modern symbols, brand logos or watermark. One isolated emblem, not a sprite sheet, not multiple versions.
Decision meaning: 筹划边境战役.
Subject: a folded ivory campaign map, one large brass compass, and two crossed short steel officer swords behind the map; a single small dark-red planning pin.
